description: This file contains a class definition for managing stock status entities in the OpenCart e-commerce platform. It includes methods for adding, editing, deleting, and retrieving stock statuses and their descriptions, interacting with the database and cache.

classes.name: StockStatus
classes.description: A model class responsible for managing stock status data, including creation, modification, deletion, and retrieval operations within the database.

methods.name: addStockStatus
methods.description: Adds a new stock status entry along with descriptions for different languages. Inserts into the stock_status table and updates related descriptions.

methods.name: editStockStatus
methods.description: Updates an existing stock status and its descriptions. Deletes the previous entry and re-inserts descriptions.

methods.name: deleteStockStatus
methods.description: Deletes a stock status entry identified by its ID from the database.

methods.name: deleteStockStatusesByLanguageId
methods.description: Deletes all stock status descriptions associated with a specific language ID.

methods.name: getStockStatus
methods.description: Retrieves detailed information of a specific stock status by its ID and current language.

methods.name: getStockStatuses
methods.description: Fetches a list of stock statuses, with optional filtering, sorting, and pagination.

methods.name: getTotalStockStatuses
methods.description: Returns the total count of stock statuses for the current language.

methods.name: addDescription
methods.description: Adds a description for a stock status in a specific language.

methods.name: getDescriptions
methods.description: Retrieves all descriptions associated with a particular stock status.

methods.name: getDescriptionsByLanguageId
methods.description: Retrieves all stock status descriptions for a specific language ID.
